commit.message:
fix: rank by the searched title's own numbers, words and authors

Replaying the audit's real listing names exposed ranking errors:
- Numbers in the searched title were cut as years or episodes, so every
  "Cyberpunk 2077" row scored 0 and "1984" ranked journal issues above
  Orwell. They are now title words, and of several bare years only the
  last is the release year ("Blade Runner 2049 (2017)" is a sequel).
- Books' Auto rule counted any row containing the title words, so a
  wrong book kept Knaben from running; it now needs the book itself.
- Movies score each title of "Russian / Original [details]" names;
  generic scoring ignores release tags typed after the title ("Saki
  720p"); tag tie-breaks accept "ptbr"/"PT-BR"-style spellings.
- Products: a listing starting with the name ranks above add-ons and
  look-alikes (2 vs 1), "7-Zip" no longer matches any .zip with a 7 in
  its version, add-ons are recognised two words back, a bare "v." is a
  version, and Mobile's Auto rule accepts those listings.
- Raw manga with kanji-only names or [JP] tags, and "[DUAL JAP PT-BR]"
  Brazilian audio, are recognised.
- Desktop/Mobile platform filters keep programs about the other
  platform ("Android Studio ... Windows", "[Android + iOS]"); game
  platform words count only at the end ("PC Building Simulator").
- Author matching accepts either name order and ignores "Jr.", the
  author lookup ignores format words, digit spelling leaves "thousand"
  titles alone and joins "Nineteen Eighty-Four" into 1984, and the
  modifier-letter apostrophe matches like the others.

Found in a final code review (GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude reviewers).

staffing: move the Decision guardrail to workbuddy-ai/grok-4.7 @ xhigh

Owner §3.4 staffing decision. §1 edited first, as the staffing rule requires.

The old §1 row named `grok/Grok 4.7` @ xhigh. This DSH installation registers no
`grok` provider, so that route could not be selected: a spawn on it was rejected
with `child LLM route "grok/Grok 4.7" is not allowed for this Session`, and
`just route-check` failed with `[roster_route_not_allowed]`. Grok 4.7 is
advertised only as `workbuddy-ai/grok-4.7` (efforts low/medium/high/xhigh).

The row is now `provider: workbuddy-ai`, `model: grok-4.7`,
`reasoning_effort: xhigh`, route `workbuddy-ai/grok-4.7` @ `xhigh`. Role name,
authority, CONTINUABLE_PINNED continuity and the GUARDRAIL_* verdict tokens are
unchanged.

`just route-check` now exits 0 with all three roster routes covered. The checker
and its matching rules were NOT touched: the roster row was corrected to the route
the active profile patch already contains.

Guardrail probe re-run on the new route (the old probe does not establish readiness
for a changed assignment): child e01fab41-5669-47b1-b96a-ebf99be20f69, continuable,
`request/header` reads provider workbuddy-ai / model grok-4.7 / xhigh, workspace is
the game repo, it read the §1 row with its own tool call and ran `git rev-parse HEAD`
itself, and turn 2 returned the turn-1 marker. PASS.

Also in this commit:

- tests/test_reviewer_routes.py: `test_the_real_receipt_keeps_its_route_facts`
  asserted the receipt contains `gpt-6.1-sol`. That route stopped being a §1
  assignment on 2026-10-03, when the separate Packet and Turn reviewers became one
  Reviewer on `claude/claude-opus-5-5` @ high, so the assertion demanded a retired
  route and the test was ALREADY FAILING at 1b7bd3d. Replaced with `grok-4.7`,
  keeping the other two assertions, so it still fails if the receipt omits a
  current probed route. This is a correction, not a loosening.
- docs/reviews/startup-current.md: Decision guardrail route and probe now PASS;
  allow-list output now exit 0; readiness now PASS for the required startup items.
  The identity line's hashes were recomputed from current bytes and its tense
  corrected: the guardrail post-check twice caught it asserting a commit that had
  not happened. The stale plan hash in the CURRENT PACKET sub-bullet is recomputed
  too. The receipt keeps the template's six sections.

Discovery work is a separate commit. No production behavior changed.
